mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users ( user_id, google_subject, nickname, email, user_type, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{googleSubject}, #{nickname}, #{email}, 'user', UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) )
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET nickname = #{nickname}, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE user_id = #{userId}
UPDATE users SET card_sort_mode = #{cardSortMode}, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT performance_closing_enabled, nearby_benefit_enabled, benefit_limit_enabled, marketing_enabled FROM user_notification_settings WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_notification_settings ( user_id, performance_closing_enabled, nearby_benefit_enabled, benefit_limit_enabled, marketing_enabled, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{settings.performanceClosingEnabled}, #{settings.nearbyBenefitEnabled}, #{settings.benefitLimitEnabled}, #{settings.marketingEnabled}, UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE performance_closing_enabled = VALUES(performance_closing_enabled), nearby_benefit_enabled = VALUES(nearby_benefit_enabled), benefit_limit_enabled = VALUES(benefit_limit_enabled), marketing_enabled = VALUES(marketing_enabled), updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET location_recommendation_enabled = #{enabled}, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE user_id = #{userId}
